newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bradesco may finance CVRD buyers - report.
newsitem.headline: Bradesco may finance CVRD buyers - report.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Bradesco may participate in the privatization auction of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) by providing financing to potential buyers, local newspapers said.
It also may participate to buy shares for an investment fund, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said.
Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros, president of the National Development Bank (BNDES), told the paper Bradesco is only forbidden to take part in the auction as an investor in a consortium.

Bradesco, which had been holding talks with private steelmaker CSN to form a consortium to bid at CVRD auction, was forced to drop out of the race after authorities banned it from participating because of a conflict of interest arising from its role as an adviser to the sale.
Now CSN is reportedly negotiating with Garantia Participacoes, Camargo Correa construction group, Suzano pulp and paper group, Opportunity, Nations Bank, Mitsui and George Soros fund.
Vale's privatization will begin with the sale of a 45 percent voting stake on April 29.
